# SPEC-ASTF-001 — Progress

`progress.md` sits outside this rule (REQ-AST-001-005 / -011), and so does the
`spec.md` beside it, which carries `status: draft` in its own frontmatter as
the schema requires. Both files are given the violating shape here on purpose:
if the rule derived its artifact set from a directory scan with exclusions
instead of a closed list, this fixture is where that would show.
